chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

It is not appropriate that you wrap yourself with an izar over a qamis while you are performing salat, and do not gird yourself with an izar over the qamis when you pray, for indeed that is from the attire of the Jahiliyyah.

key_terms.بِإِزَارٍ: with an izar, a waist-wrapper or lower garment
key_terms.تَتَوَشَّحَ: to wrap oneself with a garment across the body
key_terms.قَمِيصٍ: a qamis, a shirt or tunic

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to wear an izar over a qamis during salat in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith discourages wearing an izar over a qamis during salat. It presents this manner of dress in prayer as a disliked practice associated with the style of the Jahiliyyah, indicating an etiquette and legal discouragement in devotional conduct.
